blocks.text: Marian Rivera has addressed a long-standing rumor that she locked a fellow actress inside a comfort room, saying the alleged incident never happened. Rivera made the denial during her guest appearance on “Gandang Gabi Vice” on Thursday, Oct. 25, when host Vice Ganda asked her whether the so-called “padlock” incident was real. Without naming the other party, Rivera confirmed that she had a tiff with another actress, but they had already reconciled privately long before she addressed the issue publicly. “Pero kung ang tanong mo ay, ‘Nangyari ba talaga?’ HINDI!” Rivera said. “Never.” “’Yung totoo niyan, maayos na kaming dalawa.
